notes: This file is a reusable desired-policy blueprint, not evidence that the template source repository has these rules applied.
Apply only to a child/new project after the user approves the rules setup.
Only require status checks that have actually run successfully in the child repository and are supported by its plan/features.
Control-plane and lock-namespace protection is a security boundary, not a documentation preference.

blockers: GitHub API 403 on rulesets and branch protection: 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public to enable this feature.' Private org repo on the Free plan cannot enforce rules; GitHub Team plan required.
Repository settings writes (merge methods, delete_branch_on_merge) are not permitted through this session's GitHub proxy; owner applies them in Settings > General.
manual_steps: Settings > General > Pull Requests: allow squash merging only; enable 'Always suggest updating pull request branches', 'Allow auto-merge', 'Automatically delete head branches'.

After upgrading to GitHub Team: Settings > Rules > New branch ruleset 'main': target default branch; require PR (1 approval, Code Owners, dismiss stale, approve most recent push, resolve conversations); require status check 'repository-integrity' (up to date); block force pushes and deletion; require linear history. Add bypass for repository admins in 'pull request only' mode so the single owner can merge AI-authored PRs after checks pass.
Second ruleset for refs/heads/claims/** and refs/heads/supervisor/**: restrict creations, updates and deletions.
